urdu transliteration:
hussain jaata hai, marne ko ay meri zainab
khareeb aa gaya, ab waqt e aakhri zainab
salam tumpe, ay baba ki laadli zainab
english translation text:
Hussain goes now to meet his martyrdom, O my Zainab.
The final moments have drawn near, O my Zainab.
Peace be upon you, O beloved daughter of our father, Zainab.

urdu transliteration:
zainab ne kaha kaun hai, pardes may mera
kyun jaate ho tum chor ke bhaiya mujhe tanha
english translation text:
Zainab replied: who do I have in this foreign land?
Why are you leaving me behind, my brother, all alone?

urdu transliteration:
zainab ko har ek mor pe, tadpayegi dunya
yaad aaoge bhaiya
english translation text:
At every turn, this world will make Zainab suffer.
I will remember you, my brother.

urdu transliteration:
baad aapke hoga meri, ghurbat ka ye aalam
us waqt ghareebi bhi karegi mera matam
sadaat ko jab raah may dega koi sadqa
yaad aaoge bhaiya
english translation text:
After you, such loneliness will become my fate.
Even poverty itself will mourn for me then.
When someone offers charity to the daughters of the Prophet on the road,
I will remember you, my brother.

urdu transliteration:
yaad aayega bhaiya mujhe, armaan tumhara
tum dekh nahi paaye ho akbar ka jo sehra
dawaat koi shadi ki madine may jo dekha
yaad aaoge bhaiya
english translation text:
I will remember your unfulfilled wish, my brother.
You never got to see Akbar dressed as a groom.
Whenever I see a wedding invitation in Madina,
I will remember you, my brother.

urdu transliteration:
is maah se mansooob thi bhaiya meri khushiyan
thi sab se badi eid meri teesri shaban
shaban ke jab chand ko dekhegi ye behna
yaad aaoge bhaiya
english translation text:
All my joys were tied to this month, my brother.
The greatest Eid for me was the third of Sha'ban.
Whenever this sister sees the moon of Sha'ban,
I will remember you, my brother.

urdu transliteration:
itna tha khayaal aap ko parde ka baradar
le jaate thay tum raat ko amma ki lehad par
ab dekhegi zainab ke khule sar ko ye dunya
yaad aaoge bhaiya
english translation text:
Brother, you cared so deeply about my veil.
You would take me to our mother's grave only at night.
Now the world will see Zainab with her head uncovered.
I will remember you, my brother.

urdu transliteration:
deedar bhi hojayega beti ke bahane
kya shaam ke zindan may aaoge sulaane
soyegi nahi jab meri lori se sakina
yaad aaoge bhaiya
english translation text:
Perhaps I shall see you again through the excuse of your daughter.
Will you come to the prison of Sham to lull her to sleep?
When Sakina cannot sleep despite my lullabies,
I will remember you, my brother.
